messages:
Priya Singh: Heads up - Brixly POC demo just failed during JSON-mode function_call. Getting schema validation errors and customer is blocked.
Drew Morales: On call. Can you paste the sanitized request and the raw model payload? Streaming on/off?
Priya Singh: Not streaming. Sanitized request: {"model":"redwood/gptx-1.4q","function_call":{"name":"submit_invoice","arguments_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"},"lines":{"type":"array"}},"required":["invoice_id","lines"]}},"prompt":"..."}
Priya Singh: Model output (sanitized): {"name":"submit_invoice","arguments":"{\"invoice_id\":\"INV-101\",\"lines\":\"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"P1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":2}]\"}"}
Priya Singh: So arguments is a string (double-encoded). Validator expects object -> fails with "expected object, got string". Demo participant says this worked earlier in staging.
Raj Patel: Double-encoding often comes from older SDK versions or a middleware stringify step. Which client and SDK version?
Priya Singh: They are on our JS SDK 0.8.1 and also using a custom proxy that logs/reserializes responses.
Maya Liu: Two problems: A) double-encoded args -> unwrap before validation, B) retries without idempotency produced duplicate invoice commits when they retried after a 429. ops-bot shows a burst throttle around the failure window.
ops-bot: Rate limit exceeded for org brixly-inc  429 at 1800507832 (burst applied).
Drew Morales: Quick mitigation: add a pre-validation step to detect string arguments and JSON.parse if valid JSON. Also ask customer to add idempotency-key header for create/submit calls.
Priya Singh: Did that live (patched their proxy) and demo advanced. They still want to understand why staging passed but prod failed. Any ideas?
Raj Patel: Staging likely had lower load and didn't hit the retry/throttle path. If the proxy retried on 5xx/429 and re-serialized the response it could convert object->string. Logging/replay may reveal the reserialization moment.
Maya Liu: Created internal ticket RT-4120 to add an SDK guard to refuse string-type function_call.arguments and to auto-attempt JSON.parse before returning to user. Also add a KB note for 'avoid proxy reserialization' and idempotency examples.
deploy-bot: Created ticket RT-4120 assigned to eng-runtime.
Priya Singh: Customer asked whether Dedicated eval avoids these throttles. Sales-ops, can we offer a short Dedicated eval for launch stability? They want pricing and a 2-week trial.
sales-ops: I'll scope pricing and propose a 2-week small pool eval; will loop in account exec for ARR sign-off.
Drew Morales: Long-term engineering suggestions: 1) SDK auto-unpack stringified arguments, 2) clearer 429 retry guidance in docs, 3) add a specific API error code for truncated/partial payloads so customers can distinguish parse errors vs model output errors.
Priya Singh: For now demo recovered after proxy patch and idempotency header. Customer happy to continue. Uploading notes to CRM and will follow up on Dedicated eval. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
